excerpts: Alumni Talk by Mr. Lingaraj Sethi at School of Computer Applications
Posted on 31st Aug, 2021
School of Computer Applications, KIIT Deemed to be University organized the **2 nd “Alumni Talk Series”** on 28 th August 2021 in collaboration with the KIIT Alumni Association.

Delivering the talk, **Mr Lingaraj Sethi, Founder Cyberdine Tech Innovation Lab** (Incubation & Mentoring Platform), drew attention of students to the importance of cybersecurity and digital forensic.

During his hour long talk he shared some valuable advice about the technical skills that one must possess for becoming a cyber security expert, like networking, data management and computer network security.
More than 75 participants, faculty members, and laboratory teachers were present.
Earlier Prof.

Prof C Misra Alumni Co Ordinator, hosted rest of the session with students and faculty participants.

excerpts: Alumni Talk by Mr. Lingaraj Sethi at School of Computer Applications
Posted on 31st Aug, 2021
School of Computer Applications, KIIT Deemed to be University organized the **2 nd “Alumni Talk Series”** on 28 th August 2021 in collaboration with the KIIT Alumni Association.

Delivering the talk, **Mr Lingaraj Sethi, Founder Cyberdine Tech Innovation Lab** (Incubation & Mentoring Platform), drew attention of students to the importance of cybersecurity and digital forensic.

During his hour long talk he shared some valuable advice about the technical skills that one must possess for becoming a cyber security expert, like networking, data management and computer network security.
More than 75 participants, faculty members, and laboratory teachers were present.
Earlier Prof.
S.
Sadhana, introduced the Speaker and gave a warm welcome.
Prof C Misra Alumni Co Ordinator, hosted rest of the session with students and faculty participants.
Prof.
S Dash, Sr,Faculty Associate proposed the Vote of Thank to all guests & student participants and specially thanks to Director of the School Prof.
Veena Goswami for her kind permission to organize the event successfully.

citations.title: Alumni Talk by Mr. Lingaraj Sethi at School of Computer Applications - Newsroom - KIIT Alumni Network
excerpts: Alumni Talk by Mr. Lingaraj Sethi at School of Computer Applications
Posted on 31st Aug, 2021
School of Computer Applications, KIIT Deemed to be University organized the **2 nd “Alumni Talk Series”** on 28 th August 2021 in collaboration with the KIIT Alumni Association.

Delivering the talk, **Mr Lingaraj Sethi, Founder Cyberdine Tech Innovation Lab** (Incubation & Mentoring Platform), drew attention of students to the importance of cybersecurity and digital forensic.

During his hour long talk he shared some valuable advice about the technical skills that one must possess for becoming a cyber security expert, like networking, data management and computer network security.
More than 75 participants, faculty members, and laboratory teachers were present.
Earlier Prof.
S.
Sadhana, introduced the Speaker and gave a warm welcome.
Prof C Misra Alumni Co Ordinator, hosted rest of the session with students and faculty participants.
Prof.
S Dash, Sr,Faculty Associate proposed the Vote of Thank to all guests & student participants and specially thanks to Director of the School Prof.
Veena Goswami for her kind permission to organize the event successfully.
